claims.claim: The ObjectStack project positions a single executable business ontology as the software itself: AI authors it, a runtime executes it, agents operate it, and the user owns it, offered as an open protocol and runtime under Apache-2.0.
claims.quote: Title: GitHub - objectstack-ai/objectstack: The ontology is the software. One executable business ontology: AI writes it, the runtime runs it, agents operate it, you own it. Open protocol & runtime, Apache-2.0.

claims.claim: The remainder of the repository page is engineering changelog content about protocol compatibility handshakes (ADR-0087 D1, error code OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE, HTTP 422) and contains no definitions or relationships among ontologies, knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or context layers.
claims.quote: The install route calls the same `assertProtocolCompat` before anything is registered, written or synced.
